message.content: {"summary":"Time Loop is implemented as a substantive Godot 4 project with title, chapter menu, 24 data-driven levels, loop recording and ghost replay, timeline HUD, reset, exit gating, and completion metrics. Current evidence proves a clean build, working title-to-menu navigation, scenario-skip loading, a visible flash/rewind with ghost respawn in near_rewind, and deterministic replay for two scenario traces. However most gameplay mechanics remain unverified by runtime evidence, ordinary play never reached a level, the title trace did not replay deterministically, demo_outputs is empty, visual quality is uninspected, assets are mock placeholders, and the empty Game menu and no-op interact handler indicate incomplete shipping quality.","instruction_audit":"The original Benchmark instruction is authoritative and mostly well-translated by the Designer spec. Two design-side tensions are recorded as issues: (1) the instruction says 'layer up to four loops' while the spec/implementation allow only three recorded ghosts plus the current loop, which is a defensible reading but was not confirmed by the instruction, and (2) the instruction requires shipped demo_outputs trace files while the Developer explicitly deferred them to the Player; this must be resolved before delivery. The instruction also requires that screenshot helper evidence be used to actually inspect title, play, multi-ghost, and completion screens; no such inspection is in current evidence, so visual criteria are insufficient rather than failed. Missing original-requirement gaps (no bounded multi-loop/interactable gameplay proof, no demo package) are reported as actionable
